name: SS - FC Lookbook
description: Editorial lookbook-style featured collection with large hero product image alongside a vertical product strip. The hero slot spotlights one product with full-bleed image, editorial overlay text, and price badge. Remaining products appear as a scrollable vertical film-strip with hover zoom and quick-view details. Configurable hero position, product count, image ratios, sale badges, and staggered scroll reveals. Perfect for fashion, lifestyle, and premium brands.
